verification.notes: Contemporaneous reporting says Albert Farnsworth abducted and repeatedly raped a 12-year-old girl, pleaded guilty, and received 30 years. The episode's victim age of 13 is wrong.

sources.title: Eddie Farnsworth Blocked Hearing for Anti-Child-Sex-Trafficking Bill
sources.relevance: Reports that Albert Farnsworth’s victim was 12, not 13, while confirming the underlying sexual-assault case.
